main.summary: Version 1 codec for the dedicated `DataItem` security envelope.
main.remarks:
V1 is a `DataItem`-specific transport format with a fixed header, a recipient table, an always-present root context hash, and chunked authenticated content encryption.
The serialized layout is fixed for V1 and is divided into three parts: a fixed header, a recipient table, and a chunked ciphertext body.
The fixed header is ordered as: Version, Flags, AlgorithmSuite, ChunkSizePower, RecipientCount, RecipientTableLength, OriginalLength, and RootContextHash.
The recipient table stores one or more recipient entries. Each recipient entry is ordered as: RecipientFlags, ThumbprintLength, Thumbprint, optional RecipientObjectId, optional RecipientPublicKeyHash, WrappedMaterialLength, and WrappedMaterial.
The body is a sequence of chunk records ordered as: PlainLength, CipherLength, Ciphertext, TagLength, and Tag.

field.name: AlgorithmSuiteRsaOaepSha512Aes256Gcm
field.summary: Algorithm suite discriminator for RSA-OAEP-SHA512 with AES-256-GCM.

field.name: AesKeySize
field.summary: Content-encryption key size in bytes.

field.name: BaseNonceSeedSize
field.summary: Base nonce seed size in bytes.

field.name: ChunkLengthBlockSize
field.summary: Serialized size of the per-chunk plaintext and ciphertext length block.

field.name: DefaultChunkSizePower
field.summary: Default chunk-size exponent for the envelope.

field.name: EnvelopeMetadataHashSize
field.summary: Serialized size of the authenticated envelope metadata hash stored in the fixed header.

field.name: FixedHeaderSize
field.summary: Fixed serialized size of the V1 envelope header.

field.name: GuidSize
field.summary: Serialized size of a Guid value when present in the recipient table.

field.name: MaxChunkSizePower
field.summary: Maximum supported chunk-size exponent.

field.name: MinChunkSizePower
field.summary: Minimum supported chunk-size exponent.

field.name: PublicKeyHashSize
field.summary: Serialized size of the recipient public-key hash hint.

field.name: RecipientCountSize
field.summary: Serialized size of the recipient count field.

field.name: RecipientObjectIdFlag
field.summary: Recipient-entry flag indicating the presence of an object identifier.

field.name: RecipientPublicKeyHashFlag
field.summary: Recipient-entry flag indicating the presence of a public-key hash hint.

field.name: RecipientTableLengthSize
field.summary: Serialized size of the recipient table length field.

field.name: RootContextHashSize
field.summary: Serialized size of the always-present root context hash.

field.name: TagSize
field.summary: AES-GCM tag size in bytes.

field.name: TagSizeLengthFieldSize
field.summary: Serialized size of the per-chunk tag-length field.

field.name: Version
field.summary: Envelope version byte for V1.

field.name: WrappedMaterialSize
field.summary: Size of the wrapped content-encryption material in bytes.

record.name: RecipientEntry
record.summary: Parsed recipient entry describing one unwrap target in the envelope recipient table.

record.name: Header
record.summary: Parsed fixed header for the `DataItemSecurityEnvelopeV1` codec.

record.name: DecryptionChunk
record.summary: Internal work item used during chunk decryption.

record.name: DecryptedChunk
record.summary: Internal work item carrying recovered plaintext for ordered stream writes.

record.name: EncryptionChunk
record.summary: Internal work item used during chunk encryption.

record.name: EncryptedChunk
record.summary: Internal work item carrying encrypted chunk records for ordered stream writes.

method.name: GetEncryptedCapacity
method.summary: Estimate the serialized envelope size for a V1 `DataItem` security envelope.
method.param: Recipients that will appear in the recipient table.
Base-2 exponent used to determine chunk size.
method.returns: Estimated envelope size in bytes, or null if the requested layout is invalid.

method.name: CreateHeader
method.summary: Create the canonical fixed header description for a V1 `DataItem` security envelope.
method.param: Recipients that will appear in the recipient table.
method.returns: Canonical header description.

method.name: GetRecipientTableLength
method.summary: Compute the serialized size of the V1 recipient table.
method.param: Recipients that will appear in the recipient table.
method.returns: Serialized recipient table size in bytes.

method.name: BuildPerChunkAad
method.summary: Build the canonical per-chunk authenticated-data hash for a single ciphertext record from the root-context hash, authenticated metadata hash, chunk index, and plaintext length.
method.param: Parsed fixed header for the current envelope.
Plaintext byte length of the chunk.
Destination span for the computed per-chunk AAD hash.
method.returns: True when the per-chunk AAD hash was built successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: BuildPerChunkAadCore
method.summary: Build the canonical per-chunk authenticated-data hash directly from root-context and authenticated envelope metadata hashes.
method.param: Canonical root-context hash stored in the fixed header.
Authenticated envelope metadata hash to bind into per-chunk AAD.
Plaintext byte length of the chunk.
Destination span for the computed per-chunk AAD hash.
method.returns: True when the per-chunk AAD hash was built successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: ComputeRecipientTableHash
method.summary: Compute the canonical hash of the serialized recipient table so recipient metadata can be authenticated as a whole.
method.param: Destination span for the computed recipient-table hash.
method.returns: True when the recipient-table hash was computed successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: ComputeEnvelopeMetadataHash
method.summary: Compute the canonical authenticated metadata hash for the envelope from stable transport values, the root-context hash already embedded in the header, and the recipient-table hash.
method.param: Parsed fixed header for the current envelope.
Destination span for the computed metadata hash.
method.returns: True when the envelope metadata hash was computed successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: ComputeRecipientFlags
method.summary: Compute the serialized recipient flags for a runtime recipient description.
method.param: Recipient to encode into the recipient table.
method.returns: Recipient flags describing which optional fields are present.

method.name: DeriveNonce
method.summary: Derive the per-chunk AES-GCM nonce from the shared key material, base nonce seed, and chunk index.
method.param: Destination span for the derived nonce.
method.returns: True when the nonce was derived successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: GetMemoryStreamArray
method.summary: Return the exact byte content of a memory stream, reusing the underlying array when possible.
method.returns: Exact byte content of the memory stream.

method.name: GetRecipientEntryLength
method.summary: Compute the serialized size of a parsed recipient entry.
method.returns: Serialized recipient-entry size in bytes.

method.name: GetRecipientEntryLengthRecipient
method.summary: Compute the serialized size of a runtime recipient before it is written into the recipient table.
method.returns: Serialized recipient-entry size in bytes.

method.name: GetWrappedMaterialLength
method.summary: Compute the length of the wrapped material for a given certificate.
method.param: Certificate containing the RSA public key.
method.returns: Length of the wrapped material in bytes, or null if the certificate does not have a valid RSA public key.

method.name: NormalizeThumbprint
method.summary: Normalize a certificate thumbprint into the canonical uppercase no-whitespace form used by the envelope.
method.returns: Normalized thumbprint, or null when the input is missing.

method.name: ReadExact
method.summary: Read exactly the requested number of bytes from a stream into a destination span.
method.param: Destination span that must be filled.
method.returns: True when the destination span was filled completely; otherwise false.

method.name: ReadExactAsync
method.summary: Read exactly the requested number of bytes from a stream into a destination memory region asynchronously.
method.param: Destination memory that must be filled.
method.returns: True when the destination memory was filled completely; otherwise false.

method.name: SerializeHeader
method.summary: Serialize a parsed V1 header description into the fixed 82-byte header layout.
method.returns: Serialized fixed header bytes.

method.name: SerializeRecipientTable
method.summary: Serialize the recipient table by wrapping the shared content-encryption material once per recipient.
method.param: Recipients to write into the recipient table.
Shared content-encryption material to wrap for each recipient.
method.returns: Serialized recipient-table bytes.

method.name: TryValidateEnvelopeMetadata
method.summary: Validate the authenticated envelope metadata after parsing the header and recipient table but before decrypting chunk content.
method.param: Serialized recipient-table bytes exactly as stored in the envelope.
method.returns: True when the authenticated envelope metadata matches the serialized envelope state; otherwise false.

method.name: TryGetRemainingMemory
method.summary: Attempt to expose the unread portion of a memory-backed stream as `ReadOnlyMemory<byte>` without copying.
method.param: Unread portion of the underlying memory buffer when successful.
method.returns: True when the unread content can be exposed without copying; otherwise false.

method.name: TryParseHeader
method.summary: Parse the fixed V1 header layout from an input span.
method.param: Input span beginning at the envelope header.
method.returns: True when the fixed header parsed successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryParseRecipientTable
method.summary: Parse the V1 recipient table from a serialized input span.
method.returns: True when the recipient table parsed successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryResolveRecipientMaterial
method.summary: Attempt to unwrap the shared content-encryption material for a matching recipient using the supplied private certificate.
method.param: Parsed recipient entries from the envelope.
Certificate containing the private key used for unwrap attempts.
method.returns: True when one recipient entry was successfully unwrapped; otherwise false.

method.name: TryValidateRootContext
method.summary: Validate the caller-supplied canonical root context against the hash embedded in the envelope header.
method.param: Expected root-context hash from the envelope header.
method.returns: True when the supplied root context matches the embedded hash; otherwise false.

method.param: Certificate containing recipient private key material.
Canonical root context bytes expected by the envelope.
method.returns: Recovered plaintext and computed plaintext hash.

method.name: DecryptArrayWithHashAsync
method.summary: Decrypt an in-memory V1 `DataItem` security envelope asynchronously and return plaintext together with its computed hash.
method.param: Certificate containing recipient private key material.
Canonical root context bytes expected by the envelope.
method.returns: Recovered plaintext and computed plaintext hash.

Base-2 exponent used to determine chunk size.

method.name: EncryptArrayAsync
method.summary: Encrypt an in-memory payload into a V1 `DataItem` security envelope asynchronously.
method.param: Canonical root context bytes to bind into the envelope.
Base-2 exponent used to determine chunk size.
method.returns: Serialized envelope.

method.name: EncryptArrayWithHash
method.summary: Encrypt an in-memory payload into a V1 `DataItem` security envelope and return ciphertext together with the computed plaintext hash.
method.param: Canonical root context bytes to bind into the envelope.
Base-2 exponent used to determine chunk size.
method.returns: Serialized envelope bytes and computed plaintext hash.

method.name: EncryptArrayWithHashAsync
method.summary: Encrypt an in-memory payload into a V1 `DataItem` security envelope asynchronously and return ciphertext together with the computed plaintext hash.
method.param: Canonical root context bytes to bind into the envelope.
Base-2 exponent used to determine chunk size.
method.returns: Serialized envelope bytes and computed plaintext hash.

method.summary: Decrypt a V1 `DataItem` security envelope stream.
method.param: Certificate containing recipient private key material.

method.returns: True if decryption succeeds; otherwise false.

method.name: DecryptStreamAsync
method.summary: Decrypt a V1 `DataItem` security envelope stream asynchronously.
method.param: Certificate containing recipient private key material.
Canonical root context bytes expected by the envelope.
method.returns: True if decryption succeeds; otherwise false.

method.name: DecryptStreamAsyncCore

method.param: Certificate containing recipient private key material.
Canonical root context bytes expected by the envelope.

method.summary: Encrypt a stream into a V1 `DataItem` security envelope.
method.param: Output stream for the serialized envelope.
Canonical root context bytes to bind into the envelope.
Base-2 exponent used to determine chunk size.
method.returns: True if encryption succeeds; otherwise false.

method.name: EncryptStreamAsync
method.summary: Encrypt a stream into a V1 `DataItem` security envelope asynchronously.
method.param: Output stream for the serialized envelope.
Canonical root context bytes to bind into the envelope.
Base-2 exponent used to determine chunk size.
method.returns: True if encryption succeeds; otherwise false.

method.name: EncryptStreamAsyncCore
method.summary: Perform asynchronous V1 stream encryption using the chunked TPL Dataflow pipeline.
method.param: Output stream for the serialized envelope.
Canonical root context bytes to bind into the envelope.
